## Critique
- claim-1: The cited source supports only the stated ideal-generation claim. It does not establish the integral direct-sum presentation or completeness of the \(h_1\)-rows.
- claim-2: The bounded certificate is mathematically complete conditional on the explicitly invoked presentation and row-completeness hypotheses, as permitted by the task. The partition enumeration is exhaustive, both surviving additions are verified in-box, all other addable boxes are excluded, and the cases \(1\le k\le\min(i,j)\) and \(k=0\) are handled. The unitriangular minors and determinants \(1\) are also correct. Thus the named certificate is established conditionally, without proving or source-grounding the invoked presentation and without implying the parent theorem.

## Required revisions
- None for the conditional certificate. Any unconditional version would require separate grounding or proof of the invoked presentation facts.
